title: Rethinking Self-Evolving Agents: Do We Still Need Prescribed Optimization Pipelines?
title_zh: 重新思考自进化智能体：我们还需要预设优化流水线吗？
abstract_en: Self-evolving agents are usually built around prescribed optimization pipelines: the framework decides how to gather evidence, revise a persistent artifact, select candidates, and stop. We ask whether this task-specific procedure remains necessary when a frontier model acts as the optimizer. We introduce Open-Ended Optimization (OEO), which keeps the objective, permitted interactions, resource budget, data boundary, and evaluation fixed while allowing the optimizer to compose the improvement process online. We compare OEO with two complementary prescribed approaches: SkillOpt, a staged pipeline with bounded edits, and GEPA, a reflective evolutionary search. Across 14 head-to-head comparisons over 8 benchmark-target-model settings, GPT-5.5-driven OEO records 12 wins, 1 tie, and 1 narrow loss of 0.21 percentage points. It uses a median 34.3 percent of SkillOpt's configured target-interaction token budget. A one-shot, zero-interaction control shows that the gains are not explained by a single prior-driven rewrite. However, delegation has a capability boundary: SkillOpt outperforms OEO with a medium optimizer, and a weak optimizer cannot operate through the unchanged OEO interface. In the fully instrumented OEO-SkillOpt pair, trajectory analysis further shows that prescription changes how optimization proceeds more consistently than it changes final behavior. Together, these findings recast prescribed pipelines as capability-dependent scaffolding: essential constraints remain external, but a sufficiently capable optimizer can compose the route from measurable feedback to persistent improvement.
abstract_zh: 自进化智能体通常依赖预设优化流水线：由框架决定如何收集证据、修订持久化产物、选择候选方案以及何时停止。本文探讨当前沿模型本身充当优化器时，这类任务特定流程是否仍然必要。作者提出 Open-Ended Optimization（OEO），在固定目标、允许交互、资源预算、数据边界和评估方式的前提下，允许优化器在线自主组合改进过程。论文将 OEO 与两类预设方法比较：采用分阶段与有界编辑的 SkillOpt，以及反思式进化搜索 GEPA。在 8 个 benchmark-target-model 设置上的 14 次正面对比中，由 GPT-5.5 驱动的 OEO 取得 12 胜、1 平、1 次仅落后 0.21 个百分点的窄负，并且其中位数仅使用 SkillOpt 配置目标交互 token 预算的 34.3%。一次性、零交互对照实验表明，收益并非来自单次先验驱动的重写。不过，委托式优化存在能力边界：当优化器能力中等时，SkillOpt 优于 OEO；弱优化器则无法通过未改动的 OEO 接口有效运行。在完全可观测的 OEO-SkillOpt 对比中，轨迹分析还显示，预设流程对优化过程的影响比对最终行为的影响更稳定。总体而言，论文将预设流水线重新定义为能力依赖的脚手架：关键约束仍需外部固定，但足够强的优化器可以自行从可测反馈组织出通往持久改进的路径。
key_points_zh: 提出 Open-Ended Optimization（OEO）：固定目标、交互权限、预算、数据边界与评估，让优化器在线自主设计改进流程，而非遵循预设 pipeline。
在 14 次 head-to-head 比较中，GPT-5.5 驱动的 OEO 相比 SkillOpt 和 GEPA 取得 12 胜、1 平、1 窄负，显示强优化器可替代大量人工流程设计。
OEO 的资源效率更高：其中位数仅消耗 SkillOpt 配置目标交互 token 预算的 34.3%。
零交互 one-shot 对照说明，OEO 的提升并非简单来自前沿模型的一次性先验重写，而是依赖反馈驱动的在线优化。
能力边界明确：中等优化器下 SkillOpt 更优，弱优化器无法直接使用 OEO 接口，说明预设流水线仍是能力不足时的重要脚手架。

llm_assessment.comment: A compelling self-evolution study that challenges prescribed optimization pipelines and reframes harness scaffolding as capability-dependent.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项有启发性的自演化研究，挑战预设优化流水线，并将框架脚手架重新理解为依赖模型能力的机制。
